## Context / Problem
Slice C1 (29a9-3cf7-3ded-42d8) recorded 26 below-seam ambient config/credential reads in the cli/commands subsystem (`_cli`, `_commands`) as rows in `config_ownership_exceptions.LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS`. RP-04 is not done while these sit below the composition/credential seams enforced by `scripts/check_config_ownership.py`. Parent: 075b-1479-dcb7-40ab. Every listed read is STILL flagged when its row is drained (owner=composition in a non-root file); none are already owned.

The 26 reads (path :: symbol) — 14 `load_config` (the 14 files in Cut targets) + 12 others: `REBAR_ROOT` in `_cli/_init.py` & `_commands/init.py`; `_jira_onboard.py::{JIRA_PROJECT,JIRA_URL,JIRA_USER,os.environ.get}`; `_llm_eval_commands.py::OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT`; `bridge_repair.py::USER`; `tracker_maintenance.py::USER`; `compact_txn.py::REBAR_TEST_COMPACT_RENAME_BARRIER`; `composer.py::REBAR_DETECTED_BY`; `session_id.py::os.environ.get`.

Affected SOURCE files: the 22 above, plus `config.py`, `_config_sources.py` (owned resolvers) and `config_ownership_exceptions.py` (remove 26 rows).

## Outcome
Each read gets exactly one treatment and its `LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS` row is removed. `python scripts/check_config_ownership.py` reports zero findings for these paths, no path-glob exception. Behavioral suites stay green; operation-snapshot fingerprints / provider-neutral outcomes unchanged except recorded deltas.

## Decision rule
- **(a) CUT-TO-SEAM (default; 24 of 26).** A read whose value is composed config is CUT: routed through an OWNED `config.py`/`_config_sources.py` resolver instead of an ambient `load_config`/`os.environ` below the seam; the ambient read no longer exists. The CLI entrypoint composes once (`compose_config()`/`load_config(root)` or a narrow resolver) and threads the typed value into the below-seam helper, whose signature changes to RECEIVE it. **Preserve resolution timing:** a LIVE-per-operation read must be cut to a resolver that ALSO reads env live per call, not composed once (else a mid-operation override is lost). None of these 24 is live-per-operation (CLI resolves each once at entry), verified by the compose-once proof.
- **(b) OWNED-IN-PLACE via `# read-via:` marker (bounded allowlist ONLY).** A read that is NOT composed config — test-only injection or harness/protocol env-injection — stays with a `# read-via:` marker naming the category. CAPPED at the 2 reads below; the gate flags each accessed LINE and each is exactly 1 line, so 2 reads = exactly **2 marked lines**. No other listed read may be marked.

### Owned-in-place allowlist (2 reads = 2 marked lines — the cap)
1. `compact_txn.py` L186 `REBAR_TEST_COMPACT_RENAME_BARRIER` — test-only failpoint, inert in production (guards a mid-retirement SIGKILL barrier). Not composed config. 1 line.
2. `session_id.py` L57 dynamic `os.environ.get(var)` — harness/protocol env-injection of session identity (`REBAR_SESSION_ID`/`AI_AGENT`/`CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE_SESSION_ID`), injected verbatim by the per-harness shims and read live by the shared `resolve_session_id()`. Shim↔rebar protocol contract, not a config knob. 1 line.

## Cut targets (all reuse OWNED resolvers)
- **14 `load_config` entrypoints** (`_cli/_audit_commands.py`, `_cli/_jira_onboard.py`, `_commands/{_seam,claim,close_autoresume,compact,compact_trigger,gates,metrics,remote_cert,scratch,verify_authorship,verify_commit,verify_opcert}.py`): CLI composes `compose_config()`/`load_config(root)` once at entry and threads the typed `Config` (or the specific field: `ticket.default_assignee`, `verify.*`, `code_health`, `scratch.base_dir`, `ui.enabled`, `sync.remote`) into the helper; the below-seam `load_config` is removed.
- **2 `REBAR_ROOT`** (`_cli/_init.py`, `_commands/init.py`): duplicate root-discovery bootstrap. CUT to the OWNED `config.repo_root`/`_config_sources.repo_root(explicit)` resolver (same `explicit > REBAR_ROOT > git` precedence), preserving each caller's not-found handling (`_init` exits 1; `init` → None).
- **5 jira reads** (`_jira_onboard.py`: JIRA_URL/USER/PROJECT overlay L60-62, `_TOKEN_ENV` detection read L63, `_TOKEN_ENV` presence-gate L191, + `load_config`): `load_config().jira` ALREADY layers JIRA_URL/USER/PROJECT env over file, so the re-reads duplicate composition. CUT all to an OWNED jira-detection resolver composing file+env with the existing fail-soft (ConfigError → env-only), token at the credential boundary; it returns url/user/project + a `token_present` flag consumed by BOTH L63 and the L191 skip-validation gate — neither env read survives or is marked.
- **`OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT`** (`_llm_eval_commands.py`) and **`REBAR_DETECTED_BY`** (`composer.py`): CLI-arg-with-env-default. CUT — the `--otlp-endpoint`/`--detected-by` arg still wins; env is the composed default in an OWNED resolver.
- **2 `USER`** (`bridge_repair._actor`, `tracker_maintenance._actor`): OS-user audit fallback after git identity; both today run `git -C <tracker> config user.email` scoped to the tracker dir, else `$USER`. CUT to a shared OWNED `resolve_os_actor(tracker)` in `config.py` that TAKES the tracker/root dir and scopes the SAME `git -C <tracker>` lookup to it (git identity > `$USER` > "unknown") — preserves each caller's dir-scoped identity, no cwd delta.

## Plan
1. Reuse/add the OWNED resolvers above. Cut the 24 composed-config reads through them, threading values into below-seam helpers (signature change to RECEIVE).
2. Re-derive changed helper call sites (Serena `find_referencing_symbols` + a `grep` for the name as a string) and bring all sites into scope, or keep the helper reading from an OWNED resolver internally (signature unchanged) — state which per helper.
3. Mark the 2 owned-in-place reads with `# read-via:`; no other markers. Remove the 26 `LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS` rows. Run `check_config_ownership.py` + the suites below; keep green.

## Testing (RED -> GREEN)
Held-out `tests/scripts/test_cli_seam_clean_heldout.py` asserts: (i) `check_config_ownership.check(REPO_ROOT)` returns no finding containing any of the 22 listed paths; (ii) `LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS` has zero entries for a listed file; (iii) `# read-via:` markers across the listed files total exactly 2, confined to `compact_txn.py` (1) and `session_id.py` (1) — every other listed file has 0. (Gate scripts imported by BARE name: `import check_config_ownership`.) RED now.
Compose-once proof: a held-out fixture composes the CLI entrypoint config, THEN mutates each cut env var mid-operation and asserts the threaded value is UNCHANGED — proving each cut read is entry-time, no mid-operation override dropped.
Affected command suites (updated to inject via the new signature/typed config where a signature changed): `tests/unit/{test_audit_*,test_claim_default_assignee,test_compact_*,test_remote_cert,test_verify_commit_ticket,test_verify_opcert*,test_jira_onboard,test_session_id,test_init_*}.py`, plus `tests/interfaces/{lifecycle,queries}`. Env-setting tests that only set the cut env vars at entry need NO change — the owned resolvers read the SAME env vars; only direct callers of a changed helper signature are updated.

## Compatibility / rollback
No stored format changes. Cut-to-seam is routing/threading; the 2 marked lines are inline annotations on non-config env-control reads. Rollback = revert the change.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] No ambient config/credential read below the seam in the 22 listed files: each is cut-to-seam (24) or one of the 2 owned-in-place reads (2 marked lines) with a `# read-via:` rationale; no other read marked; any live read cut to a live-per-call resolver.
- [ ] The 26 `LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS` rows removed; `python scripts/check_config_ownership.py` passes with no path-glob exception (proven by the held-out test incl. marker-total==2 / per-file-placement).
- [ ] The Testing suites pass after cutover; operation-snapshot fingerprints / provider-neutral outcomes unchanged except deltas recorded as a comment.
